description:
Gravity Circuit is a fast 2D action platformer: grapple with your hookshot, punch robots, and
take back the Guardian Corps HQ from the Virus Army, one Circuit stage at a time.

v0.10.0.description:
### New
- **Fortress Access Items** (`fortress_access`, off by default): Fortress 1 and Fortress 2 are opened by
  "Fortress 1 Access" and "Fortress 2 Access" items found in the multiworld, instead of by bosses. Only
  Fortress 3 (the final boss) still needs `bosses_required`, which shortens go mode.
  - Only the 8 Circuit stage bosses count toward `bosses_required`. Fortress 1 and 2 are never needed for the goal.
  - The stage select shows all three Fortress stages and locks each one separately.
- The PopTracker pack tracks the two new items and the new setting automatically.

### Logic
- These checks now require the **Air Jumper** chip on Normal logic:
  - Fortress 2 - Small Cache 11
  - Fortress 2 - Small Cache 12

### Fixes
- Fixed generation failing when `money_caches` or `small_money_caches` is off. This affected 0.9.1.
v0.10.0.title: Gravity Circuit v0.10.0

v0.10.1.description:
### Changes
- **Rescue Tokens are progression** when shopsanity is on. The Nurse's Shop logic counts them on top of the
  tokens you get from rescue bots, so her chips can come into logic earlier. With shopsanity off they stay filler.

### PopTracker
- The pack (now 0.6.0) tracks how many Rescue Tokens you've received and counts them in the Nurse's Shop logic.
v0.10.1.title: Gravity Circuit v0.10.1

v0.11.0.description:
### New
- **Linux / Steam Deck support (Proton).** When WinHTTP's websockets aren't available, the client connects through
  LÖVE's LuaSocket instead (`ws://` only; archipelago.gg and self-hosted servers accept it). Run `sh install.sh`
  to install the mod into the game's Proton prefix.
- **Shopsanity info in the shop itself.** The shop's description box shows what the selected slot sends and to
  whom, with the item name coloured by class (progression, useful, filler, trap).

### Changes
- **New overlay.** Messages use the game's font, coloured like the Archipelago text client, and sit in the bottom
  left so they no longer cover the health bar. The AP status line moved to the top; it hides a few seconds after
  connecting and comes back when disconnected, paused or with F9 open.
- Money cache pickups and applied refills no longer print a message.
- **Clearer connection errors.** The client says what went wrong (unknown host, nothing on that port, timeout,
  not an Archipelago server, wrong slot or password) and what to check. Pasted addresses are cleaned up, and a
  bad address or a refused connection no longer retries forever.
- Fewer hitches: server messages are decoded off the main thread, data packages are cached between connections,
  and the log is written in batches.

### Logic
- **"Data Chip - Nega"** now requires all 8 stage Access items. The chip is inside the HQ healing tube, which only
  opens after all 64 rescues.

### Fixes
- Fixed checkpoint refills not filling the new segment after receiving a Burst Booster.

### PopTracker
- The pack (now 0.7.0) shows hub NPC data chips (Fix, Shock, Yuki, K.I.D, Amadeus, Mighty, Tech) as Inspect until
  the rescue that brings that NPC to HQ is checked, and follows the new Nega logic.
v0.11.0.title: Gravity Circuit v0.11.0

v0.12.0.description:
### New
- **Item sprites in the shops.** With shopsanity, a slot holding another game's item shows that item's sprite
  instead of the chip or burst icon, from KaitoKid's
  [ArchipelagoUtilities](https://github.com/agilbert1412/ArchipelagoUtilities) asset database. Items without a
  sprite show their game's icon; games not in the database keep the normal icon. Sprites are downloaded once per
  game and cached in `archipelago\sprites\`.
- **`wss://` on Linux / Steam Deck.** The socket connection now does TLS through Schannel (Wine has it too), so
  secure servers work under Proton. It is now the default on Windows as well, with WinHTTP as the fallback.
- **WebSocket compression.** The client supports `permessage-deflate`, so the server no longer warns about it.

### Changes
- Data chip pickups, received filler items and traps no longer print a message.
v0.12.0.title: Gravity Circuit v0.12.0

v0.9.1.description: Fixed a logic hole of a check named "Highway - Money Cache 1" in Highway not requiring Air Jumper chip on normal logic
v0.9.1.title: Gravity Circuit v0.9.1
